name: Bungo-yaku: Taisho-kaiyaku (NT) (1950), Meiji-yaku (OT) (1953)
statement: This Bible is in the Public Domain.

evidence.quote: Classical Japanese Bible, Public Domain. Combination of Classical Japanese Bible, the New Testament published in 1917 (so called Taisho-Kaiyaku) and the Old Testament published in 1887 (Meiji-Yaku).

verification.note: The translations were published in 1887 (OT) and 1917 (NT); the 1950/1953 printings are the base text.
